reviews.x: I've been doing my own gel nails for about 4 years and have only had access to what is available at Ulta or at Sally's which will run from $9 to $15 a bottle! I'm so happy I found Gellen on Amazon! I am very pleased with the quality and color vibrancy of each color. For the price and quality, it is a bang for your buck. I typically use 2-3 coats of gel color, so this is no different. Works well with an LED light. The brush is high quality and very easy to handle and doesn't fan out during applic

These are great colors! I do get them to last a full 3 weeks if prepped right. I use them with the LED lamp (and base/top coat) from the SensatioNail kit I already had, and it works perfectly! (cure 60 seconds).  These have way more color options, are way more affordable, and just as good on shine/longevity etc. Just went back to order 12 more colors.

I ordered number 10 set and I loved it. Colors are pretty and stays up to 3 weeks(photo of my toenails already 3 weeks with gellen) Looking forward ordering more different colors for that price.:)I received this product for free in exchange for an honest and unbiased review.

This polish has gone above and beyond my expectations! Compared to the brands I typically use, the colors seem more vibrant and the polish stays on better.  The polish itself had no strong smell unlike other brands of gel polish I've used. The consistency was perfect (not to thick and not too thin) and after two weeks; this polish is still as vibrant as when I applied it.  Sometimes I experience cracking in the polish and/or fading near the tips of my nail. This was not the case with this polish
Not satisfied with it.. I'm using high quality gelish for base and top but every time I'm using this product it just lasts for few days less than a week

I am mostly impressed with the customer service which mea

reviews.t: Great gel for a low price
reviews.x: This being my first try at doing my own gel polish at, I was pretty nervous. I really had nothing to worry about. The only tricky thing is application. The Gellen is a fairly thick consistency so I had to go slow and figure out how much to leave on the brush. Try to do the thinnest coats that you can and as carefully around the edges of your nails. It cures easily. Fyi - I used CND's base and top coat and swiped my nails with isopropyl alcohol before applying the base coat. Mixing brands didn't

I bought the wine red series. The colors were not what’s in the picture. I bought the set for the deep red. Out of the 6 colors 2 are bright red. 2 are the brownish red color and the other two are very similar but slightly different. Very disappointed that the colors don’t match what’s in the picture

reviews.t: Colors are not exact matches to the picture
reviews.x: I love the polish, it lasts for at least 2 weeks with the correct top and base cost. However, the colors are not true to the picture. The last two are darker than shown, and the second and third are lighter. I still kept the set, because I liked the colors.

reviews.t: Good starter set for the price
reviews.x: Inexpensive but took longer than anticipated to dry. Also did not cost as thick as I expected with 2 coats. Could still see the flaws/uneven areas in my nails. Once dried it does last a long time. My younger girls were very pleased.
Happy with product but never would have chosen 5 of these colors. Colors online not at all representative of actually colors. Better to try the choose your own option than get a preset 6 pack.
Muestran unos colores y llegan en la caja colores completamente direntes y nisiquiera son colores bonitos son feos.

reviews.t: You won’t get all the colors as pictured!
reviews.x: The colors were not like photo. Instead of having six different colors, there is only two.
Polish looks great!! Nice finish!! Bye-bye Nail salon

Surprisingly impressed- I normally use Red Carpet Manicure brand gel polish and the Gellen brand seems to be more like salon quality gel polish. The top coat definitely took a few rounds under the UV light to cure but worked perfectly once I figured out it needed more time- the top coat seemed to wipe off after 30 seconds but was perfect after 2 minutes. Four stars because there’s no label/color name/color sticker on the bottles to designate what color polish is inside, which is annoying.

The polish was good quality, but the colors are not like the ones shown. The Reds were very similar to each other and the dark purples were very similar to each other. I put two different colors on each hand, and you were barely able to tell that they were even different. To me, it looks like two colors in one box with a very slight variation. Not like pictured. However, they do stay on and they do look nice. Worth the buy. Just wish they were more like the picture.

Just like the salon! Everything works just the same and is legit what one would expect to receive at the salon for a gel nail manicure. I’ll be using this for a long time. Side note: I did a terrible job on the actual application in my photos because I was trying to really hurry but it’s really easy to use and it still turned out well.

reviews.t: Great price, but a bit of a pain to see color.
reviews.x: The price is right, for sure!  Unfortunately, you cannot tell the nail color until you open the bottle.  There isn't a sticker on the outside to show which color the bottle contains.  You can get stickers, paint and cure each color onto each one, then stick on the bottle, but it is a pain and takes a lot of time.

The polish itself is great. Goes on smooth, vibrant, and easy to apply. The bottles do not have any indication of what color it is so I painted the bottles myself. I know colors on a computer are difficult to portray, so I cant be too upset, but the colors were definitely different than I hoped.

reviews.t: I finally just picked one and am very pleased with this product
reviews.x: First time using Gel Nail polish with the nail dryer.  There are so many brands to choose from.  I finally just picked one and am very pleased with this product.  Nail polish stayed on longer with no chips, than when I use to go to the spa to get them done.  Completely satisfied!

reviews.t: Don’t buy! It’ll damage your nails
reviews.x: What you pay that’s what you get. Colors completely don’t match picture. Out of 6 colors you get 3 because it differs just by one shade. Also it totally damages your nails. Just after one use, wearing it for one week my nails became paper thin. Very painful.

reviews.t: Easy to apply and drys quickly
reviews.x: This polish goes on well and dries quickly, which is what I love about gel polish. However, it doesn't last more than a week. Mind you, I have my hands in and out of water and cleaning solutions and only remember to wear gloves about 50% of the time.

The bottles are on the smaller side, but for the price, its worth it. You must shake the bottles before applying. Good one time coverage. Colors of polish are never what they look like on the computer, but they are nice colors. Will buy more.

Ordered wine red set. Two of the bottles were brown rather than wine red. The other four are so similar in color I can’t tell them apart. Thought I was getting 6 different shades and instead got four red and two brown. Not worth the money.

I love these gel polishes! I got them literally the same day I ordered, and tried them the same day as well. The colors are exactly what i ordered and work amazing! I would recommend these to anyone and everyone! Worth every penny. :)

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the vibrant, pretty colors and good value for the price.
Many reviewers report the polish lasting up to about 2-3 weeks when prepped and used with proper base/top coats.
A common complaint is that the actual colors do not match the pictures shown online.
Some reviewers note the consistency is thick and application can be tricky or take longer to dry.
A few reviewers report poor longevity, with the polish lasting less than a week.
